newsitem.title: USA: Applied Cellular retires preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: Applied Cellular retires preferred stock.

text.p: Applied Cellular Technology Inc said Tuesday it has completed the retirement of $4.8 million in preferred redeemable shares and 480,000 warrants to purchase common shares.

According to the transaction, Applied Cellular will issue 650,000 shares of restricted common stock (with a transaction value of $7.38 per share) to a co-founder of ATI Communications. ATI is Applied Cellular's largest subsidiary with projected 1997 sales of over $30 million.
Applied Cellular had issued the preferred redeemable shares and warrants in the September 1996 acquisition of ATI, which provides telephone and telecommunications systems and services.

In a news release, Applied Cellular also repeated that it expects 1997 earnings of $0.30 a share based on about 7.4 million shares outstanding, up from the $0.19 a share reported in 1996 based on about 3.3 million shares outstanding.
Sales are estimated at about $79 million, up from about $20 million reported in 1996.
Shares of Applied Cellular were trading off 1/16 to 3-5/16.
